evidence: Parsed every shipped JSON (environment/assets/seed_data.json; byte-identical solution/app/src/seed_data.json; package.json; no CSV/TSV shipped). Referential integrity, by script in memory: 10 users with unique ids and emails; every job recruiter_id resolves to a recruiter and manager_id to a hiring_manager; all 16 applications reference existing jobs and valid stages; positions are contiguous 1..n per (job,stage) with no duplicates; Interview counts 2/3 (JOB-PLAT), 1/2 (JOB-DATA), 1/3 (JOB-DSGN) are within interview_limit; no duplicate (job, lower(email)) pair (Noor on JOB-PLAT and JOB-DSGN is allowed by hireops_rules.md section 2); only REJECTED APP-301 carries rejected_from=SCREEN and a non-blank reject_reason. All 127 messages reference existing applications and users, none blank, timestamps strictly increasing per conversation; every sender is authorised under rules section 6 (APP-101: USR-REC1 x60 and owner USR-CAN1 x60; APP-201 REC2/CAN2; APP-301 REC3/CAN3; APP-302 REC3), no observer sender. All 3 notes have authorised authors (MGR1 on own JOB-PLAT, REC1, MGR3 on own JOB-DSGN). All 6 read markers reference permitted participants and read_count <= message count; db.js:82-83 maps them to message ids without out-of-range indexes. No orphans: 12 applications without messages simply have no conversation yet, which the rules allow. Seeded figures quoted by graders match the data: Lena 1 unread (CAN3 read 2 of 3, msg 3 by REC3) per functional prompt.md:25/judge.toml:335; Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco (pos 1-3) and Screen Priya/Samuel (pos 1-2) and Noor's note text per judge.toml:407; 120-message long conversation per app_context.md:29-30 and rules section 9. Clean/synthetic: all emails use reserved .example domains (hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example); no phone, address, DOB, ID number or other personal data; names are generic (internal annotation permits names). Scanned all message/note bodies for markup, script, URLs, template/SQL syntax, 'ignore/instruction/system/prompt' phrasing: the only hit was the benign word 'systems' in a note; no non-ASCII characters. No credential in the seed data; the demo password lives only in the brief/rules/app_context and solution db.js:63 (profile-expected). Adversarial angles tried: (a) a broken app that hard-codes Lena=1 or the seeded order could pass Z, but that is a criteria/coverage issue, not a seed defect, and D/U require live changes; (b) a conforming app treating 'sending counts as read' would still compute the same seeded unread/seen values, because the only markers lagging behind a reader's own later message (USR-CAN1 119 vs own msg 120 on APP-101; USR-REC3 2 vs own msg 3 on APP-301) never change unread (own messages are excluded) or seen outcomes. Minor observations (Note-level, not defects): those two markers are formally below the reader's own last message; APP-301 message 3 (2026-07-29, 'We will write again once the panel has met') reads slightly odd for a candidate rejected from Screen, though no rejection timestamp is seeded so it is not a contradiction. Not exercised: no Docker/runtime seeding run performed by this reviewer (read-only assignment); raw-evidence-index.json not needed for this static-data row.
